about_the_game:
Uncover the secrets of a broken society

The Marble Palace has fallen to war and, while its last defenders try to fend off the vicious attacking forces, you find an ornate ceremonial key, which opens the door to the kingdom's best kept secret. Will you be able to uncover it?

Features and mechanics:

  • Classic 2D side-scrolling adventure with a twist - adventure through the third dimension thanks to the plane change mechanic. Explore the palace in every axis!

  • Tight 2D movement and platforming.

  • Make use of the varied platforming mechanics such as air-dashing, double jumping and your very own grappling scarf!

  • Unlock new powerful and useful abilities throughout your journey!

  • Meet many friendly (and not so friendly) characters. Your choices might influence their destinies.

  • A beautiful score, composed by canary group Macaca Radiata, will accompany your every step.

A short and sweet experience

The game compacts a lot of what one might find on a classical action-exploration game into a short time span. We estimate it will take around two and a half hours for an average player to beat, while more experienced and cunning players might beat it in one and a half hours... or less! Please, take this into account before joining us for the adventure.

short_description: Embark yourself on an adventure through the Marble Palace and uncover the plentiful secrets it hides! Explore magnificent views and fight through the hostile halls of the palace, all while making use of the innovative plane change mechanics!

English*, Spanish - Spain*, German*
